recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. If a work group wants a general 11073-20601 mapping-space target beyond Device/PHD-specific mappings, handle that as a separate issue with explicit scope and expert review.
issue_request: FHIR-26571 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to include ISO/IEEE 11073-10207 (BICEPS) in the FHIR-core mappings list, with 11073-10201 and 11073-20601 mentioned as potentially beneficial additional targets; the final disposition was to update mappings.html by having Grahame explain the mapping-list update path to Bjoern.
initial_application: Commit 9d49e5a66ea66447b43122a74d91d62f74034a57 added DIM and BICEPS entries to source/mappingSpaces.xml with a commit message referencing Jira #26571, and commit 40a264d6c9915619331a97613f511789b9505664 normalized those mapping URLs to urn:iso:std:iso:11073:10201 and urn:iso:std:iso:11073:10207.
additional_context: The current mappings page source contains the mappings-table include, and source/mappingSpaces.xml publishes DIM, ACOM, and BICEPS mapping spaces with current IEEE links and titles. Later Device-specific work in FHIR-51425 and title cleanup in FHIR-53150 updated the same 11073 mapping family; FHIR-51425 is already represented on the combined branch. The seed's optional 20601 note is not a separate final core-mappings-page requirement for this audit; Device/PHD 20601 work is a separate Device artifact trail, including FHIR-23847.
reconciliation: No source changes were made because the current source already lists and publishes ISO/IEEE 11073-10207/BICEPS on the mappings registry that feeds the mappings page, and the related DIM addition is also present. Adding another 20601 mapping-space entry would broaden this Published FHIR-I decision beyond its applied source history and the later Device-specific decisions.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied Device-specific 11073 mapping work reused and normalized the ACOM, DIM, and BICEPS mapping spaces; it is already audited on the combined branch and was not duplicated here.
Later Applied title cleanup confirmed that DeviceAlert should use the existing BICEPS 11073-10207 mapping identity and updated titles/links.
Earlier Published Device-specific IEEE 20601 mapping table request explains the seed description's 20601 context, but it concerns FHIR-core-Device rather than the FHIR-core mappings page.
